content.text: Jakeh capa Agur ni a dei e lawk.
Ama ni Ithiel, Ithiel hoi Ucal koe hettelah a dei.
Tamipueng hlak tamipathu poung lah ka o teh,
thaipanueknae hai ka tawn hoeh.
Lungangnae hai kamtu van hoeh niteh,
tamikathoungnaw e panuenae hai ka tawn hoeh.
Kalvan ka luen ni teh ka kum e teh apimaw,
Talai poutnae pueng kacaksakkung teh apimaw,
A min apimaw, a capa min hai apimaw, na panue maw.
Cathut lawk pueng teh a thoung,
ka kânguenaw pueng hanelah kânguenae lah ao.
A lawk hah thap hanh, hoehpawiteh na yue vaiteh,
na laithoe e hah a hmu han.
Hno kahni touh ka hei han,
ka due hoehnahlan na poe haw.
Ahrawnghrang hoi laithoenae heh kai hoi
ahlanae koe na tat pouh haw, mathoenae nakunghai,
tawntanae nakunghai na poe hanh,
ka panki e rawca hoi na kawk haw.
Hoehpawiteh ka tawnta vaiteh na pahnawt payon vaih,
BAWIPA teh apimaw, ka tet payon vaih.
Hoehpawiteh, ka mathoe vaiteh hno ka parawt vaiteh
Cathut min ka mathout sakpayon vaih.
San teh a bawi koe pathoe hanh,
hoehpawiteh thoe na bo vaiteh,
nang dawk yonnae ao han.
A na pa thoe a bo teh
a manu yawhawi a poe ngaihoehnae se ao.
Ama mithmu vah kathoung poung lah kâpouknae ao,
hatei a khinnae koehoi pâsu hoeh rah.
Khopouk ka rasang ni teh moungnae a o,
a khopouk teh a rasang katang.
A hâ teh sendek patetlah,
a hâkamnaw teh sarai patetlah a onae se a o,
het talai van e tami mathoenaw hoi
kavoutthoupnaw hah koung ca hanelah kakâcainaw doeh.
Tavat ni canu kahni touh a tawn teh,
na poe na poe a ti.
Ka boum thai hoeh e kathum touh ao.
A khout toe ka tet boihoeh e hno pali touh a o
Tangkom, kating e thun,
tui ka boum hoeh e talai,
a khout toe ka tet boihoeh e hmai naw hah doeh.
A na pa ka dudam niteh
a manu banglah ka noutna hoeh naw e mit teh,
vonga ni a cawngkhawi pouh vaiteh,
matawcanaw ni a ca awh han.
Kai hanlah kângairu hno kathum touh a o,
ka thaipanuek hoeh e hno pali touh teh,
Kahlî dawk mataw kamlengnae lamthung,
Lungphen van tahrun ceinae, tuipui van long ceinae,
hoi thoundoun ni tangla painae lam naw hah doeh.
Napui kahawihoeh hai hottelah doeh ao van,
a ca hnukkhu a pahni a hui teh yonnae ka sak hoeh, telah ouk a ti.
Hno kathum touh kecu talai heh taki hoi ouk a pâyaw,
bokheiyah, hno pali touh khang thai hoeh e ao.
Siangpahrang lah kâsak e san,
king ka boum e tamipathu,
Vâ ka sak e napui kathout,
a bawipa e yu ka khawng e sannu hetnaw hah doeh.
Talaivan a thoungca eiteh
a lungkaang e hno pali touh ao.
Atha awm hoeh eiteh kompawi vah
ama hane rawca ka pâtung e lungkhi,
a tha ayoun eiteh
lungha rahak kaawm e saveh.
siangpahrang tawn hoeh eiteh
ahuhu lahoi ka cet e samtong,
a khok hoi a kâbang eiteh
siangpahrang im kaawm e bombanaw hah doeh.
Hno kathum touh kahawicalah ka cet thai e a o,
bokheiyah pali touh hah teh,
Saring pueng dawk athakaawme sendek,
bang ni hai ngang thai hoeh.
Ransa marang, hmaetan,
apinihai ngang thai hoeh e siangpahrang hetnaw hah doeh.
Mahoima kâtalue totouh na pathu pawiteh,
hoehpawiteh hnokathout sak hanelah na kâcai pawiteh,
na kut hoi na pahni tabuemh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, maitosanutui kalaw e ni
sanutuikamkak a tâcosak e patetlah,
hnawng kapennae ni hnawngthi a lawng sak.
Hot patetlah lungkhueknae ni kâyuenae a tâcokhai.
